name: Vector RP — final palette
rationale: Cold-scale charcoal + cyan baseline (--rp-accent) for HUD chrome and brand primitives; sodium-amber (--rp-accent-warm) for heist/violence beats and street-light frames. Duotone discipline lands on the GTA V / True Detective / Sicario reference set; cyan-only would land Mr. Robot, which is the wrong adjacent. Magenta/purple is reserved for VZU publisher canon and never appears in product chrome. --rp-bg-tint is the raised-surface step for layered HUD panels; --rp-fg-muted sits in the same hue family as --rp-fg, desaturated for secondary text; --rp-error and --rp-success stay grounded (deep blood-red, muted teal-green) instead of bright UI semantics.
